name: Grey seal
note: The grey seals (B3 wave 3; doc 12 autumn and winter, doc 13 'Shaped, not found'): a few that haul out on a quiet sandbar the player raised, and a white pup in early autumn. A seasonal life: no tier milestone, no gift (Matt, October 30, 2026), watching only. MODEL (assets/models/seal, Matt's, credited there): the body a game copy cut to about 6,000 triangles, eyes and jaw as he made them; body.model names the files. src/world/seals/model.js turns it head toward +z, scales it to body.lengthM and rigs it in code (rig: stations along the body in the file's own units, head toward +x: the spine chain's bones at x, with y their pivot height where given; the jaw's hinge; the fore flippers (L the seal's own left, the file's -z side, and R; each at its own station x as Matt posed them, holding the span of x below yMax), their pivot y and side, the share of the body's half width (measured above aboveY, over the flippers) out to the shoulder, in..out the blend past the body's side (file units); the hind flippers from x 'from' back, over 'blend', pivots spread either side). COAT (seal-draw.wgsl, no UVs: painted from the rest pose): coat.grey base, darker back, paler belly, mottle (blotch size in metres, cut, strength), wet darker and glossier fresh out of the water (dryS to dry), the pup's cream white (pup.white), moulting to grey patches over its last days. LIFE (src/world/seals/live.js): hauled out on the home bar each lies at its own spot (spacingM apart, dry ground above the tide); they lie curved, breathe, look about, scratch with a fore flipper and shift now and then; on land they hump (humpMps), in water deeper than swimDepthM they swim (swimMps, hind flippers sweeping) or bottle, upright with the head out. A spot the tide covers sends its seal to a dry spot within dryReachM of home, or into the water to bottle near home until it dries. PRESENCE: the walker only (the camera above is never felt). Inside the wary ring at Wary they hump into the water, swim out flushM and bottle there watching you, coming back after settleS once you are beyond twice the ring; past Wary they only lift their heads. A mother never leaves her pup. Trust: watching only (feedTrust 0, ceiling Curious); knownTrust their group moment: a seal swims in and bottles near you while you stand still within joinM of the water's edge. ECOLOGY (kind flock, src/world/creatures/flock.js): the schools' arc with the home bar as their one pool (room: areaM2 of the bar, arrival.m2PerOne a seal); a bar the walker crossed is not quiet (S0), so they grow uneasy and leave after leaveGraceDays. The meadow islet's bar counts while you keep off it (shaped.js). PUP (src/world/seals/pup.js, in the hourly tick): on a seeded day of the year within pup.days (29 to 35, early autumn), with the home met, a mother hauls out with a white pup; it stays pup.stayDays, white until moultFrom days, then moults and goes to sea with her. visit: the S0 visit until the home is made: a seal bottling off the shore for an hour.

presence._trust: Their trust (F13 section 8): one for the group, 0..1, saved (state.creatures.seals.trust), only ever grows, earned by quiet watching only. bands: where Tolerant, Curious and Familiar begin; ceiling Curious. knownTrust: the group moment (creature:known).

feed.none: The seals fish for themselves out in the sea.
